name: First Republic Bank
regulator_evidence: EDGAR CIK 0001132979 holds only filings others made about it (SC 13G, SC 13G/A, 40-6B/A), no 10-K or 10-Q (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001132979.json, read 2026-11-06); FDIC-supervised (https://www.fdic.gov/news/press-releases/2023/pr23073.html)
closing_source: Closed 2023-05-01 by the California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation, FDIC receiver, deposits to JPMorgan Chase Bank N.A. (https://www.fdic.gov/resources/resolutions/bank-failures/failed-bank-list/first-republic.html; https://www.fdic.gov/news/press-releases/2023/pr23034.html)
exit_source: NYSE suspended trading immediately and began delisting the common and preferred on 2023-05-02; trading halted before the 2023-05-01 open, so the last NYSE session is 2023-04-28 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20230502005774/en/NYSE-to-Suspend-Trading-Immediately-in-First-Republic-Bank-FRC-and-Commence-Delisting-Proceedings)

name: Signature Bank
regulator_evidence: EDGAR CIK 0001288784 holds only filings others made about it and SEC letters (SC 13D, SC 13G, SC 13G/A, D, REGDEX, UPLOAD), no 10-K or 10-Q (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001288784.json, read 2026-11-06)
closing_source: Closed 2023-03-12 (a Sunday) by the New York State Department of Financial Services, FDIC receiver, operations to Signature Bridge Bank N.A., deposits later to Flagstar Bank N.A. (https://www.fdic.gov/resources/resolutions/bank-failures/failed-bank-list/signature-ny.html)
exit_source: Nasdaq halted SBNY at 04:00:01 ET on 2023-03-13 (last sale USD 70.00, the 2023-03-10 session) and never reopened it; later traded over the counter (https://www.tipranks.com/news/press-releases/nasdaq-halts-signature-bank; https://investorplace.com/2023/03/delisted-bank-stocks-signature-and-svb-financial-start-trading-otc/)
